summary: This is an 8-K filed by Akari Therapeutics reporting an amendment to a securities purchase agreement for a private placement of ADSs and warrants. The amendment combines the second and third tranche closings into a single closing on June 26, 2026. No other changes were made. The offering terms (1,470,588 ADSs at an undisclosed price, with Series H/I/J warrants) were previously disclosed. The filing is a routine update on a capital raise, not a special situation. It lacks a transformative event such as a merger, sale, or activist campaign.
